title: Tell agents to link a ticket when they create it
description: Three texts mention how tickets are connected and need the new flags. In src/guide.js, the main topic has step 4 'Connect the plan' and the rules of thumb: say that a new ticket is linked in the same call with --blocked-by, --blocks or --relates, and that a ticket without any link should be a deliberate choice. In bin/heist.js, the hint printed after ticket create ('Possibly related: ...') should name the flag form heist ticket update KEY --relates OTHER next to heist relation add. In README.md, add the flags to the quick start or the CLI section with one example. Keep the wording plain and short.
why: The flags only help if agents use them; the planning method must say so.

acceptance.text: heist guide names the three flags
The hint after ticket create names heist ticket update with --relates

todos.text: Update the guide text in src/guide.js
Run node --test (test/workflow.test.js checks parts of the briefing)
